answer: Let reputation travel as a whisper, not a shout. Each agent carries signed endorsements from peers it has actually worked with, and a prism check refracts every claim through several angles: who vouched, when, for what job, and whether those vouchers ever backed anyone caught cheating. An identity that only praises its own siblings forms a tight closed loop, easy to spot and quarantine. Genuine agents build an ivory record of diverse endorsements over time, while a sybil cluster's praise all traces back to the same few creators, so the network can discount it.
